propositions: Deterministic mutant corpus and pre-registered thresholds were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally NOT landed on main.

The ~100-run LLM batch baseline sweep to measure gate detection power and blocking false positives is permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder that produces the same signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.

Pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) with golden tests were built to enforce INDETERMINATE run-validity cap (≥0.20) and multi-criteria set-intersection attribution for five defect classes.
Store isolation was implemented by construction using git clone --local --branch with standalone .git directory to prevent mutation commits from contaminating the real tracker.
History-based baseline mining is dead due to impact_model_version bump stranding ~96 of ~200 needed plan-v3 sidecar baselines, leaving only ~4 viable baselines.
